QUOTE: A single-token miss gets the strong "definitive" wording only if the `file_docs` table exists (`has_file_docs`). ... `q.unsearched_corpora` ... takes the kinds the database holds, subtracts the kinds `search` reads, and counts matching names in what remains. Any hit replaces the verdict with "NOT DEFINITIVE"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the "definitive" wording depends on a per-query check of which corpora search did not read (`unsearched_corpora`) and on whether `file_docs` exists. That check runs on every empty reply, not on the result shape.
